messages:
emily: Heads-up — new user report from onboarding sample app. They hit a 401 during a long pagination run and our JS SDK retried bursts of concurrent requests. Client-side throttle windows got saturated and backend started returning 429s, so the sample app stalled. :grimacing:

raj: ugh. do we know which retry path triggered? token refresh loop or request retry middleware?

emily: looks like token refresh returned 401 for one request, SDK attempted refresh+replay but the replayed requests didn't get queued by the paginator; instead they all retried immediately. Minimal log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T15:02:10Z] fetchPage(42) -> 401
[2026-03-20T15:02:10Z] auth.refreshToken() -> ok
[2026-03-20T15:02:10Z] retry(replay) x8 concurrent -> 429
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] throttle.window(saturated) -> dropping
```

sam: hmm that matches a race between token refresh callback and the paginator backpressure. Our paginator uses a simple leaky-bucket per cursor but replay bypasses that.

lena: can we change replay path to go through the same enqueue logic? Also add jittered backoff and per-cursor maxConcurrency to avoid cross-cursor thundering herd.

raj: agree. proposal: route all replays through paginator.enqueue(), add a replayGuard that sets a short randomized delay, and cap replay concurrency per cursor to 4. Example config for sample app: 
```
const rdConfig = {
  paginator: { maxConcurrencyPerCursor: 4, enqueueTimeoutMs: 5000 },
  auth: { refreshReplayWindowMs: 250, jitterMs: [50,300] },
  clientThrottle: { tokensPerSec: 20, burst: 40 }
}
```

emily: that looks good. also need to update docs and the quickstart sample that people run during signup. the current quickstart uses defaults that are too aggressive.

sdk-bot: CI check: found 1 failing test in js-sdk/paginator/test/replay.spec.js — reproduction harness failing due to nondeterministic timing.

sam: i'll add deterministic timers in the harness and a test for replay going through enqueue. tagging @lena for review on the config API.

lena: will review. can we also add telemetry so we can see "replay_count" and "replay_concurrency" per cursor in Console? ops asked for that.

raj: yeah I'll add metrics + a small console visual for sample app onboarding funnel. opening issue: https://redwood.ai/issue/4589 — PR incoming.

emily: thanks team. next steps: raj to PR the replay->enqueue change, sam to fix tests, lena to review, and emily to update quickstart snippet. Please keep this thread updated with PR links. :thumbsup:
